title: Design of a Product
description: Definition of design in relation to a product

content.legal_definition: the intended or known physical and material characteristics of such product and includes any intended or known formulation or content of such product and the usual result of the intended manufacturing or other process used to produce such product
content.plain_language: the planned and intentional features, composition, and production outcome of a product
examples: the design of a car includes its intended engine type and safety features
the design of a food product includes its intended ingredients and nutritional content
